data.name: Abductor
data.description: At 3rd level, a Bekyar kidnapper gains a +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple a foe. In addition, the Bekyar kidnapper treats her combat maneuver bonus as 1 higher when a foe tries to grapple her or when a grappled target attempts to break free of her grapple. These bonuses increase by 1 for every 3 levels beyond 3rd. This ability replaces trap sense.
